from openpyxl import Workbook
from openpyxl.styles import Font
from openpyxl.worksheet.datavalidation import DataValidation
from openpyxl.utils import get_column_letter

companies = {
    "Apple": {
        "industry": "Consumer Electronics",
        "website": "https://www.apple.com",
        "social": "https://x.com/apple",
        "products": [
            ("iPhone 15", 1299, 0.32),
            ("MacBook Air", 1599, 0.28),
            ("iPad Pro", 1399, 0.30),
            ("Apple Watch", 699, 0.35),
            ("AirPods Pro", 349, 0.40),
        ],
    },
    "Samsung": {
        "industry": "Electronics",
        "website": "https://www.samsung.com",
        "social": "https://x.com/SamsungMobile",
        "products": [
            ("Galaxy S24", 1199, 0.29),
            ("Galaxy Tab", 899, 0.27),
            ("Samsung TV", 1799, 0.25),
            ("Galaxy Watch", 499, 0.33),
            ("Samsung SSD", 249, 0.38),
        ],
    },
    "Nike": {
        "industry": "Apparel",
        "website": "https://www.nike.com",
        "social": "https://www.instagram.com/nike",
        "products": [
            ("Air Max", 220, 0.45),
            ("Dri-FIT Shirt", 55, 0.50),
            ("Pegasus Shoes", 180, 0.42),
            ("Sports Hoodie", 120, 0.48),
            ("Training Shorts", 65, 0.52),
        ],
    },
}

wb = Workbook()

# Main company sheet
ws_main = wb.active
ws_main.title = "Companies"

main_headers = [
    "Company Name", "Industry", "Website",
    "Social Media", "Product Sheet"
]

for col, header in enumerate(main_headers, 1):
    cell = ws_main.cell(row=1, column=col, value=header)
    cell.font = Font(bold=True)

row = 2
for company, data in companies.items():
    ws_main.cell(row=row, column=1, value=company)
    ws_main.cell(row=row, column=2, value=data["industry"])
    ws_main.cell(row=row, column=3, value=data["website"])
    ws_main.cell(row=row, column=4, value=data["social"])
    ws_main.cell(row=row, column=5, value=f"{company}_Products")
    row += 1

# Product sheets
for company, data in companies.items():
    ws = wb.create_sheet(title=f"{company}_Products")

    headers = [
        "Product Name",
        "Retail Price",
        "Estimated Margin %",
        "Estimated Cost",
        "Department",
        "Stock Status",
        "Category"
    ]

    for col, header in enumerate(headers, 1):
        cell = ws.cell(row=1, column=col, value=header)
        cell.font = Font(bold=True)

    # Dropdown validation
    status_validation = DataValidation(
        type="list",
        formula1='"In Stock,Low Stock,Out of Stock"',
        allow_blank=True
    )
    category_validation = DataValidation(
        type="list",
        formula1='"Electronics,Apparel,Accessories,Industrial"',
        allow_blank=True
    )

    ws.add_data_validation(status_validation)
    ws.add_data_validation(category_validation)

    r = 2
    for product_name, price, margin in data["products"]:
        cost = round(price * (1 - margin), 2)

        ws.cell(row=r, column=1, value=product_name)
        ws.cell(row=r, column=2, value=price)
        ws.cell(row=r, column=3, value=margin)
        ws.cell(row=r, column=4, value=cost)
